messages:
Eli (Sales): Hey team — kickoff thread for StormBridge POC. They're asking for SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, fine-grained RBAC for tenant admins, domain claim controls, and a quote for monthly committed Dedicated capacity. Also sent over a short security questionnaire. Can we confirm blockers and next steps?
Priya (Solutions): Thanks Eli. Quick checklist: 1) SAML IdP flow and cert rotation, 2) SCIM delta support + rate limits, 3) RBAC roles mapping UX, 4) domain verification flow for multi-tenant. Which of these are deal-breakers for them?
Eli (Sales): They said SCIM delta + SCIM bulk handling is required (onboarding 2k users/week). Domain claim verification must support wildcard subdomains. RBAC: they need delegated tenant admins and ability to restrict model access per tenant.
Sam (SE): For SCIM bulk rate: we usually recommend Dedicated with burst autoscale or Private for heavy provisioning. Can ask infra for a sustained SCIM QPS target — what does 2k users/week translate to in ops? Rough calc: ~=300/day, should be fine but delta sync spikes matter.
Marcus (Security): Got the questionnaire. Main asks: data residency, key management (customer KMS/HSM), audit logs retention, SSO session timeout policy, SAML metadata signature verification. We support customer-managed KMS for Private; Dedicated has KMS integration options but needs contract. Audit logs retention configurable on Redwood Console (default 90d). I'll draft answers.
Priya (Solutions): For RBAC: we can support role templates (admin/editor/viewer) + custom roles via API. Model-level restrictions are achievable with per-route policies. We'll need to document enforcement: policy snippets, e.g.:
```json
{ "role": "tenant_admin", "allow": ["invoke:model:prod-*", "manage:users"] }
```
Eli (Sales): Pricing ask: they want committed monthly for Dedicated GPUs with an option to burst to hosted pool. Can we give a blended monthly quote + overage rate?
Sam (SE): Yes — finance prefers a commit + overage model. I can pull a rough quote: base commit for 2x A10G equivalent for steady-state, burst pool @ 1.5x cost per token. I'll need expected qps and token/sec profile.
Eli (Sales): I'll ask StormBridge for peak RPS and expected token throughput. Also they prioritized SOC2 and encryption at rest in the doc. Marcus — can you confirm SOC2 status and where encryption keys live?
Marcus (Security): We are SOC2 Type II. Encryption at rest by default in our cloud, customer KMS for Private. For Dedicated, customer KMS via partner integration is supported with entitlements. I'll attach the SOC2 cert link in the response doc.
Priya (Solutions): POC plan proposal: 2-week POC. Week 1: connect SAML + SCIM test tenant (we do SCIM ingest of 500 users), validate domain verification flow. Week 2: RBAC templates + perf run (simulated traffic) and cost telemetry. Need SE + security call with their infra on day 1.
Eli (Sales): Sounds good. Can we commit an SE slot next Tue 10am PST? Also we may need an Engineering offramp if SCIM deltas exceed our standard rate limits.
Sam (SE): I can take Tue 10am. I'll prepare a short test harness and a sample SCIM load script (will post link).
Marcus (Security): I'll join the day-1 call for the questionnaire walkthrough. One potential blocker: if they require HSM-backed keys in Dedicated without an enterprise contract we need legal signoff. Flagging now.
Eli (Sales): Noted. I'll surface the HSM ask to their procurement and legal early.
Priya (Solutions): One more operational note: domain verification wildcard — we support ACME/HTTP proof and DNS TXT. For multi-tenant with wildcard subdomains we prefer DNS TXT + org-level claim. Will document both flows.
Eli (Sales): Great. Action items: Eli — request traffic profile + contract ask; Sam — sample SCIM harness + quote draft; Priya — POC runbook; Marcus — security questionnaire answers + SOC2 link. Let's reconvene after you post drafts. :thumbsup:
DevOncall Bot: Reminder — create a POC workspace in Console and tag with "stormbridge-poc" within 24h.
Eli (Sales): Thanks bot — creating now.
Sam (SE): Posting SCIM test script: https://internal.tools/scim-harness/stormbridge (draft).
Priya (Solutions): I'll start the runbook doc and share in #sales once ready.
Marcus (Security): Draft questionnaire responses uploaded to /docs/security/stormbridge-sq-1770011223.pdf
Eli (Sales): Team — nice fast sync. Will update once StormBridge returns throughput numbers.
Priya (Solutions): FYI might need eng-runtime help if they want near-zero SCIM latency during delta spikes. Tagging @eng-runtime in the runbook.
Eli (Sales): Good call. End of thread for now.
